elements.title: domain — Facility aggregate
elements.html:
A facility is created from an approved credit request and owns its limit, its drawdowns and its status. The limit can only change through a decision recorded with four-eyes approval.

Invariants

  • The sum of drawdowns never exceeds the limit.
  • A limit change needs two approvers from different teams.
  • A closed facility accepts no drawdown.

sections.title: Non-functional requirements

sections.title: Security

sections.title: Risks

sections.title: Open questions

arbs.title: SEPA Instant through the payment hub

reviewers.name: Claire Martin
reviewers.note: Reuses the hub; no second payment stack.

conditions.text: Screening and fraud scoring fail closed: a time-out rejects the payment within the scheme limit.
Fraud scoring p99 under 150 ms measured in pre-production with production volumes.

sections.title: Context and scope
sections.html: Meridian receives SCT Inst through a partner bank but cannot send it. The EU Instant Payments Regulation requires sending at the price of a standard transfer. In scope: the payment hub, a new SCT Inst connector, real-time sanctions screening and fraud scoring. Out of scope: cross-border instant (target, ISO 20022).

sections.title: Business need
sections.html: Every customer can send instant payments 24/7. Today 0 % of outgoing euro payments are instant; competitors offer it for free; the regulation makes it mandatory.

sections.title: Architecture overview
sections.html: The payment hub routes SCT Inst messages to a new connector on the Kubernetes platform. Screening and fraud scoring are called synchronously with a strict time budget; Kafka carries payment events to fraud, AML and the data platform.

sections.title: Non-functional requirements
sections.html: 10 s end to end at p99, 99.95 % availability 24/7, 400 payments per second at peak, no planned downtime: rolling deployments only.

sections.title: Security
sections.html: Mutual TLS to the scheme, keys in Vault, fail-closed screening (condition C1), fraud thresholds owned by the fraud team, audit trail per payment.

sections.title: Risks
sections.html: Scheme certification slips (mitigation: test window booked); screening vendor latency (mitigation: condition C2 measurement); weekend operations staffing.

sections.title: Open questions
sections.html: Pricing of instant for corporate bulk files; whether request-to-pay joins this plateau or the next.
